title: Lifecycle Fragments (v0.4)
description: Definitions-only lifecycle fragment for the v0.4 lifecycle contract (RFC 0002). Consumers select the fragments they need via $ref from this file; this document is not a validator for any full manifest format.

Status.description: Lifecycle status. Only 'deprecated' and 'removed' are normative; any other value is informational.

Deprecated.description: Canonical deprecation record for native manifest entities. Permissive on unknown properties.

message.description: Human-readable reason plus migration guidance. Never parsed for lifecycle meaning.

removal.description: Removal target: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, semver X.Y.Z, or quarter YYYY-Qn. Only ISO dates drive time-aware severity.

replacement.description: Machine-readable replacement identifier, scoped by entity type.

StrictDeprecated.description: Closed deprecation record for the DTCG extension namespace.

message.description: Human-readable reason plus migration guidance. Never parsed for lifecycle meaning.

removal.description: Removal target: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, semver X.Y.Z, or quarter YYYY-Qn. Only ISO dates drive time-aware severity.

replacement.description: Machine-readable replacement identifier, scoped by entity type.

oneOf.description: Explicit 'not deprecated' assertion in a native manifest. DTCG source cancellation uses the standard `$deprecated: false` field, not an extension value.

DeprecatedValue.description: Deprecation record for a specific attribute value (CEM). Permissive on unknown properties.

message.description: Human-readable reason plus migration guidance. Never parsed for lifecycle meaning.

removal.description: Removal target: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, semver X.Y.Z, or quarter YYYY-Qn. Only ISO dates drive time-aware severity.

replacement.description: Machine-readable replacement identifier; for CEM attribute values, an enum value of the same attribute.
